meta.title: BPMS Order Demand
meta.description: Sign in to BPMS (CPSales) and read/edit order-demand records by section/field name, upload attachments, with backup and rollback. In the order workflow it hands the OS version to /flash, then uploads the package built by /cpservice to the preinstall field (never uploads when the order is not in draft/暂存 state). Credentials live in the plugin config; command /bpms.
